author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The shadow deployment must trigger automatically the moment a new model version is committed to the pipeline. We cannot rely on a human to remember to start the validation run, especially when the supplier contract for the next promotion week is already locked. I want the system to catch any regression in real time before it touches the live forecast. The more immediate and frequent these automated checks are, the safer our production environment remains. This is a clear need for higher reliability, and I am asking for the full automated loop to be built into the CI/CD process now.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that more immediate and frequent automated checks make the production environment safer, indicating that exceeding the baseline request for a single trigger would increase their satisfaction.
